name: Las Navas de la Concepción (Spain)
description: Light blue field with four white bars rising in steps from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Las Navas de la Concepción (a column and a figure on red).
history: Municipal flag of Las Navas de la Concepción; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four stepped bars rising from the lower hoist towards the upper fly
